newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 1996 C/A surplus widens to 25.1 bln francs.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 1996 C/A surplus widens to 25.1 bln francs.

text.p: Switzerland's current account balance of payments surplus rose by 0.1 billion Swiss francs in 1996 to 25.1 billion, the Swiss National Bank said.
The trade surplus rose 0.1 billion to 1.9 billion, while the services surplus increased to 15 billion from 14.9 billion, the SNB said in an advance summary of its February monthly report.
The surplus on labour and capital income rose by 0.1 billion to 14 billion, while the deficit on the transfer account was unchanged at 4.9 billion.

The fourth-quarter 1996 surplus rose by 0.6 billion compared with the year-earlier quarter to 7.2 billion. Main components were a 1.2 billion trade suplus (up 0.2 billion), a 3.2 billion services surplus (up 0.1 billion) and a 4.1 billion labour and capital surplus (up 0.3 billion). -- Zurich +41 1 631 7340
